operations.label: Five-piece crown section above the brick
operations.directionLabel: Steady the scanner. Start with the highlighted crown half directly above the replacement site. Pinch its opposite low lips, lift the four curved slopes and the plate underneath together, and set it in the nearer bench position without turning it
operations.stopLandmark: the piece or intact section rests clear of the scanner in its indicated bench position
